verses.text: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

segments.text: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint:
Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.text: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;

segments.text: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers,
From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;

verses.text: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, And have aimed their arrows, even bitter words,

segments.text: Who have whet their tongue like a sword,
And have aimed their arrows, even bitter words,

verses.text: That they may shoot in secret places at the perfect: Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

segments.text: That they may shoot in secret places at the perfect:
Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.text: They encourage themselves in an evil purpose; They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who will see them?

segments.text: They encourage themselves in an evil purpose;
They commune of laying snares privily;
They say, Who will see them?

verses.text: They search out iniquities; We have accomplished, say they, a diligent search: And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.

segments.text: They search out iniquities;
We have accomplished,
say they
, a diligent search:
And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.

verses.text: But God will shoot at them; With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.

segments.text: But God will shoot at them;
With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.text: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them: All that see them shall wag the head.

segments.text: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them:
All that see them shall wag the head.

verses.text: And all men shall fear; And they shall declare the work of God, And shall wisely consider of his doing.

segments.text: And all men shall fear;
And they shall declare the work of God,
And shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.text: The righteous shall be glad in Jehovah, and shall take refuge in him; And all the upright in heart shall glory.

segments.text: The righteous shall be glad in Jehovah, and shall take refuge in him;
And all the upright in heart shall glory.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
